data.name: Gulsoomah
data.gender_notes: Gulsoomah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Gul' meaning rose and 'Soom' meaning garden, conveying the image of a beautiful rose blooming in a garden. The name Gulsoomah carries the meaning “Rose in the Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gulsoomah usually hope their child will grow to embody rose in the garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's grace and beauty in nature.
data.etymology: Gulsoomah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rose in the Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gulsoomah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: جلوسمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جَلوسمة: من جَلَسَ، وجَلَسَ، وَجَلُسٌ، وَجَلَوسٌ، فَلَمّا أَصبَحَتْ مِنَ الجَلَسِ مَقصورَةً صَنَّفوا في الفعلِ مِنَ الجَلَسِ جَلُوسَةً، وَجَلوساً، وَقالوا جَلوسَةٌ مِنَ الجَلَسِ مِنَ المَرأَةِ الَّتِي نَجَتْ مِنَ النارِ، وَأُخِذَ مِنَ الجَلَسِ مِنَ الرَجُلِ الَّذِي قَعَدَ في المَنزِلِ، وَقالوا الجَلوسُ مِنَ الرَجُلِ الَّذِي رَجَعَ مِنَ الجَلَسِ، وَقَولهمُ جَلوسَةٌ مِنَ الجَلَسِ أَي المَذَكرَةُ، وَقَولهمُ جَلوسَةٌ مِنَ الجَلَسِ أَي المُؤَنَّثَةُ

in_urdu.name: جلوسمة

in_hindi.name: जलूस्मा
in_hindi.long_meaning: जलूस्मा: यह एक अरबी नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है जालालत, मुकद्दसा, ताहिरत। इसके अर्थ में भी है जिसमें अल्लाह की जालालत का चमकती हुई रोशनी हो।

in_pashto.name: جلوسمه
